At most it reduces background respiratory context for clinicians but does not meaningfully alter immediate treatment decisions.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated contains no allergy information (penicillin allergy not documented).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of a beta-lactam antibiotic in subsequent care, which may trigger an allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. This is a clinically significant safety risk even if antibiotics were not part of the immediate plan in this encounter.
